command.refresh.title: Claude Control: Refresh
config.statusBar.desc: Show live Claude plan usage (session · week) in the status bar.
config.statusBar.show5h: Show the 5-hour (session) usage gauge in the status bar.
config.statusBar.show7d: Show the 7-day (weekly) usage gauge in the status bar.
config.statusBar.showContext: Show the session context usage gauge in the status bar.
config.statusBar.colorMode.desc: How the status-bar usage gauges are colored.
config.statusBar.colorMode.adaptive: Adapt to the theme — neutral when healthy, native warning/error highlight at high usage (always legible, even on a colored status bar).
config.statusBar.colorMode.usage: Fixed usage ramp — green → amber → red by how much you've used.
config.statusBar.colorMode.custom: A single fixed color you choose (set it in Custom Color).
config.statusBar.colorMode.none: No custom color — use the theme's default status-bar text color.
config.statusBar.customColor.desc: Color used when Color Mode is "custom" (e.g. #cccccc or #ccc). Leave empty to use the theme default.
config.statusBar.customColor.err: Use a hex color like #cccccc or #ccc, or leave empty.
